decisions.reason: The coolant pressure booster system extends the firm's established coolant and pumping knowledge, so the firm can assimilate results and refine it rather than drop it.
The coolant cleaning centrifuge leverages existing filtration and separation expertise, enabling the firm to interpret early results and improve the product.
The coolant nozzle line builds on established coolant delivery knowledge and multiple models offer learning within the firm's absorptive capacity.
The scraper belt chip conveyor is close to existing conveying systems, allowing the firm to apply related knowledge to improve and keep it.
The magnetic belt chip conveyor draws on established conveying and magnetic separation capabilities, supporting effective learning and improvement.
The hinged belt chip conveyor is closely related to existing chip handling products, giving the firm the absorptive capacity to exploit early results and keep it.
